name: Persistent Home Directories
description: Persists selected directories in the remote user's home across dev container rebuilds

paths.description: Colon-separated directory paths relative to the remote user's home.

onCreateCommand: uid=$(id -u); gid=$(id -g); if [ "$uid" -eq 0 ]; then chown -R "$uid:$gid" /var/lib/devcontainer-persistent-home; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n chown -R "$uid:$gid" /var/lib/devcontainer-persistent-home; else echo 'persistent-home: passwordless sudo is required for a non-root remote user' >&2; exit 1; fi
